title: Employing an integrated computational simulation strategy to identify high-affinity ligands for TDP-43 amyloid proteins.
authors: Gao, Yunqing; Sun, Zhenghao; Wei, Qiumei; She, Chenyuan; Wang, Yafeng; Chen, Jingyun; Wang, Mengxuan; Gui, Xinrui; Xia, Xue; Liu, Yang; Wang, Xin
one_liner_zh: 该文用虚拟筛选、MD和结合自由能计算寻找TDP-43淀粉样蛋白的高亲和配体，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作与MD方法，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Developing high-affinity ligands targeting TDP-43 amyloid species is a potential therapeutic approach for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Here, we propose an integrated computational simulation strategy, which integrates multiple virtual screening methods, molecular dynamics simulations and binding free energy evaluations. Using this strategy, we successfully identified TDPL1, a high-affinity ligand for TDP-43 amyloid proteins. In vitro affinity assays confirmed the computational predictions. Based on the MD simulation results, we further investigated the binding mode between TDPL1 and TDP-43 amyloid proteins. Additionally, steered molecular dynamics simulations were employed to assess the impact of TDPL1 on the stability of beta-sheet interactions within the TDP-43 amyloid structure. Our data demonstrate that TDPL1 not only binds effectively to TDP-43 amyloid proteins but also possesses the potential to disrupt the stability of amyloid aggregates. These findings provide a molecular foundation for the future development of diagnostic agents or targeted therapeutics for ALS and related diseases.
abstract_zh: 开发靶向TDP-43淀粉样蛋白的高亲和力配体是治疗肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的潜在策略。在此，我们提出了一种集成的计算模拟策略，该策略整合了多种虚拟筛选方法、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟及结合自由能评估。利用此策略，我们成功识别出TDPL1，一种针对TDP-43淀粉样蛋白的高亲和力配体。体外亲和力实验证实了计算预测的结果。基于MD模拟结果，我们进一步研究了TDPL1与TDP-43淀粉样蛋白之间的结合模式。此外，采用定向分子动力学（steered molecular dynamics）模拟来评估TDPL1对TDP-43淀粉样结构内β-折叠相互作用稳定性的影响。我们的数据表明，TDPL1不仅能有效结合TDP-43淀粉样蛋白，还具有破坏淀粉样聚集体稳定性的潜力。这些发现为未来开发针对ALS及相关疾病的诊断试剂或靶向治疗提供了分子基础。
